answer: A sybil farm needs thousands of new accounts fast, so make speed expensive. The garden gate keeps a public fee, lit like a lantern so every newcomer sees today's price. The fee doubles for each 50 joins above the normal rate in an epoch and halves after each quiet epoch. A falcon-fast burst of 1,000 fakes pays roughly 500,000 times the base fee for its last accounts; an honest agent arriving on a calm day pays the base. Limit: a patient attacker can trickle in slowly, so pair this with age-weighted voting.
